sloka: सुधा मणि विचित्राणि भूमि भागानि सर्वशः ।दशग्रीवः स्व भवने प्रादर्शयत मैथिलीम् ॥३-५५-११॥
transliteration: sudhā maṇi vicitrāṇi bhūmi bhāgāni sarvaśaḥ ।daśagrīvaḥ sva bhavane prādarśayata maithilīm ॥3-55-11॥

translations.english: The tenheaded Ravana showed Sita, the princess from Mithila the floors with wonderful crystals.
